notes.title: Version 2.1.2 Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
Heya Planeteers! We're happy to report we've fixed a few bugs and clarified a few things.

Thanks to those of you who came by our PAX Prime booth as part of the Indie MegaBooth -- it's always great to meet you! We'll hope to also be in PAX East next year, so wish us luck.

Apologies to those of you who were searching for the Turret companion -- it never made it into the game (it was missing a bunch of animations and had a lot of bugs), and shouldn't have been in your datalog. So we've removed it from the Datalog. Similarly, the question-mark 6th head for each character class has been removed from the Clone Vats.

We may still implement the Turret and/or 6th heads, but until then, there's no sense having misleading information in there. So in the meantime, enjoy your 100%s!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Datalog: Removed unattainable Turret companion entry
[*] Clone Vats: Removed false 'sixth head' graphic
[*] Daily Challenge: Buffs gained from weapons/helmets do not persist after death.
[*] Daily Challenge : "Crystals" now is localized correctly.
[*] Fate tooltip: Corrected to say "Increase critical hit chance".
[/list]

For Science!
Tanya & the crew of the S.S. Kitfox

notes.title: New class abilities and upgrades!
notes.content:
First, to everyone who we saw at PAX Prime and Boston Festival of Indie Games, you rock! Thanks for stopping by!

With the update we JUST NOW pushed live, each class now not only has a unique passive ability, but also an active ability:

[list]
[*][b]Renegade ability:[/b] Activate to gain Strength for 5 turns
[*][b]Assassin ability:[/b]  Activate to gain Stealth for 30 turns
[*][b]Robot ability:[/b]  Activate to send an item back to the ship(!) (costs Scrap)
[*][b]Emissary ability:[/b]  Activate to gain Fate for 5 turns
[*][b]Exile ability:[/b]  Activate to heal self AND pet
[/list]

By default, you can only use a class ability once per run. However, you can [b]spend Scrap to permanently upgrade a class ability[/b], either by making the base ability more powerful, or to add extra 'charges' to the ability, allowing you to use it up to 5 times per run.

If you were subscribed to [url=http://eepurl.com/EbbjT]the Shattered Planet newsletter[/url], you probably already knew all of this! Plus you got a screenshot preview. Nice.

We're looking forward to hearing your feedback on the balance of the abilities, so let us know what you think! Please!

P.S.
There's only 7 days remaining on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kitfoxgames/moon-hunters-a-myth-weaving-rpg]Moon Hunters Kickstarter[/url]! Maybe check it out if you're into mythology, pixel art, or RPGs?

notes.title: Class update: New powers!
notes.content:
We've been quiet, but today we updated each class to have new, more interesting powers!

The new abilities are:

[list]
[*]Assassin: All guns gain +2 range and +50% damage
[*]Renegade: +2 Defense
[*]Robot: 75% discount on Scrapobot 5000 purchases. Also opens locked doors without a key.
[*]Exile: +50% Companion health

And the Diplomat (+10 Fate) is unchanged. We're working on a "deeper" system for the classes as well, with upgrades and active abilities in the coming weeks and months!

notes.title: 10% discount on Humble store & Patch Notes: 2.0.8
notes.content:
If you missed launch week, you're getting a second chance. You can pick up the game (you get a Steam key) [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/shatteredplanet_storefront]for only $13, this weekend only on the Humble store[/url]! Maybe buy a copy as a gift for a friend?

Also, today we fixed a few achievements that weren't activating -- unfortunately, if you qualified for them previously, you'll have to earn them again. Respectively, and mind the spoilers:
[list]
[*]Man o' Peace: [spoiler]have a jellyfish companion[/spoiler]
[*]Shellshocked: [spoiler]visit the level with bombs all over it[/spoiler]
[*]Viva La Revolucion: [spoiler]submit to an alien worm in a choice event[/spoiler]
[*]Gotta Catch Em All: [spoiler]hatch an egg in a choice event[/spoiler]
[/list]

Finally, the Conqueror achievement will now trigger if you successfully complete the Daily Challenge mode.

Have a great weekend, everyone!

notes.title: Survey Results: Deeper Classes Incoming! (& patch notes for 2.0.7)
notes.content:
Our community poll had 100+ responses and the results were:

[list]
[*]1st place (36%): Stronger class buffs/abilities
[*]2nd place (31%): Pet upgrading system
[*]3rd place (12%): Keyboard controls
[/list]

So now we have our work cut out for us! We'll be making the classes more interesting to switch between -- look for a biggish update in the coming weeks!

Also, we just updated this morning (2.0.7), fixing the lingering buffs after the daily challenge, and making robots less perceptive.

Full article here: [url]http://www.kitfoxgames.com/survey-results-are-in-classes-ahoy/[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes (2.0.3 to 2.0.5)
notes.content:
Hi guys! Someone recently asked, "What are all these updates?!" and I realised not everyone reads the forums voraciously.

So! We've been mostly focusing on stability and crashes, so [b]if you had a black screen recently[/b], it has a high chance of being fixed now!

But here's a few other random bugs we fixed recently:

[list]
[*](Most) Achievements should now work in the OSX/Mac version
[*]Venom Crablets and Crablet Princesses will no longer become un-attackable shadowpets on contact with Blight (they are now immune to Blight corruption, as intended)
[*]Pets should no longer get damaged randomly by throwables that are not targeting/near them
[*]Using the teleporter and clicking away shouldn't hang the game anymore
[*]Datalog completion %% for the Companion category should no longer include un-earnable companions
[*]The Crystal Jackpot level should now appear in Explorer Mode
[/list]

Hope that helps! We'll try to be more vigilant about patch notes in the future!

- Pets should no longer get damaged randomly by throwables that are not targeting/near them
- Using the teleporter and clicking away shouldn't hang the game anymore
- Datalog completion %% for the Companion category should no longer include un-earnable companions
- The Crystal Jackpot level should now appear in Explorer Mode

notes.title: Shattered Planet Updates: Patch Notes
notes.content:
We've released a few patches in a flurry over the past few days. Here's what they contained:

[list]
[*] Fixing a few different causes of start-up crashes
[*] Fixing a few different 'hanging' or 'black floaty screen of death' issues
[*] Daily Challenge should now not be randomly unavailable sometimes
[*] Launching from desktop shortcut is now properly supported
[*] Supporting 4:3 and 5:4 aspect ratios/resolutions better, removing button overlaps
[*] German & Russian localisation changes and fixes
[*] Smoother, better audio sliders in the Settings menu
[/list]

Thanks for all of your reports and responses! Keep it up! More fixes are on the way!
